source: Written for this project, NOT AI Video Bootcamp material: how specific materials and foods actually respond to light - refraction, glaze highlights, condensation, translucency, grease sheen, uneven browning. Replaces lighting_bank.json's one generic 'material response' sentence with the materials the scene really contains.
note: Read from Subject, Wardrobe, Setting and Action (build_material.py). Each material is matched by whole-word keywords; matches are used in the order the text mentions them, at most `max_phrases`. `excludes` drops another match that would contradict this one - iced coffee is cold, so it never gets the coffee's rising steam. A `weak` entry names a shape, not a material (a bowl can be steel, glass or clay): it counts as ceramic only when nothing else in the text names a material, so 'a metal bowl' is metal alone. No match gives nothing - a phrase about a material the scene does not contain is worse than none. When something matched, build_prompt removes lighting_bank.json's generic `material-response` sentence from an explicit lighting choice, so the prompt never says the same thing twice. Wood here is GRAIN only: the warm bounce off wood belongs to scene_light_bank.json.

eyeglasses.label: Glasses (eyewear)
eyeglasses.phrase: the lenses of the glasses catching a small reflection of their surroundings and faintly bending the view behind them

cold_drink.label: Cold drink / condensation
cold_drink.phrase: condensation beading on the cold glass, a few droplets running down and pooling at its base

glass.label: Glass
glass.phrase: the glass refracting and slightly bending what sits behind it, a crisp highlight running along its rim

coffee.label: Coffee / tea
coffee.phrase: a thin curl of steam rising off the coffee, a soft highlight sliding across its surface

ceramic.label: Ceramic / porcelain
ceramic.phrase: the glazed ceramic holding a soft, rounded highlight of the light source, the glaze slightly uneven

vessel.label: Bowl / cup / plate
vessel.phrase: the glazed ceramic holding a soft, rounded highlight of the light source, the glaze slightly uneven

metal.label: Metal
metal.phrase: the metal reflecting a warped, darkened version of its surroundings, highlights small and sharp

jewellery.label: Jewellery / gold / silver
jewellery.phrase: small, intense glints on the jewellery that shift with the angle, the metal slightly dulled where it is worn most

leather.label: Leather / suede
leather.phrase: the leather creased at the bends, a soft sheen on the raised grain and duller hollows in the creases

silk.label: Silk / satin
silk.phrase: the silk throwing long, liquid highlights that ripple along each fold

sheer.label: Thin fabric / linen / sheer
sheer.phrase: the thin fabric letting light through where it is backlit, glowing softly at the edges with the weave faintly visible

knit.label: Wool / knit
knit.phrase: the knit's fibres catching the light as a faint fuzzy halo along the edges, each stitch casting its own tiny shadow

denim.label: Denim
denim.phrase: the denim's twill weave visible in the light, faded paler along the seams and raised creases

plastic.label: Plastic
plastic.phrase: the plastic showing a soft, slightly milky sheen, faint scuffs catching the light

paper.label: Paper / books
paper.phrase: the paper's matte surface absorbing the light, its edges slightly curled and the fibres just visible

stone.label: Stone / marble
stone.phrase: the stone's veining and fine pits catching the light unevenly, polished areas holding a soft, blurred reflection

wood_grain.label: Wood grain
wood_grain.phrase: the wood's grain and pores visible where the light rakes across it, worn smoother and darker where hands touch it most

wet.label: Wet surfaces / rain
wet.phrase: wet surfaces turning darker and glossier, water beading into small droplets with tiny bright highlights

ice_cream.label: Ice cream
ice_cream.phrase: the ice cream starting to melt at the base, a glossy drip running down the side

bread.label: Bread / pastry
bread.phrase: the crust browned unevenly, darker at the edges, flaky crumbs scattered beside it

baked_sweet.label: Cake / cookies
baked_sweet.phrase: crumbs and a slightly uneven, hand-made finish, the frosting smeared where the knife passed

pizza.label: Pizza / melted cheese
pizza.phrase: the melted cheese glistening with a thin sheen of oil, blistered and browned in uneven spots

grilled.label: Grilled meat
grilled.phrase: a glossy fat sheen on the grilled surface, char marks uneven in depth and colour

chocolate.label: Chocolate
chocolate.phrase: the chocolate's soft satin sheen, slightly melted and smudged where it has been touched

soup.label: Soup / sauce
soup.phrase: tiny droplets of oil catching the light on the surface, steam softening the air above it

fruit.label: Fruit
fruit.phrase: the fruit's waxy peel holding small, soft highlights, with natural blemishes and slight bruising

salad.label: Salad / vegetables
salad.phrase: the leaves crisp with a few droplets of dressing, edges slightly wilted and uneven
